## History

Timothy Cotton originally lived with his lazy family at [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) before relocating to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley). At one point, he stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Sowerby's dairy, falsely claiming to his wife that he had purchased it. He eventually passed away after spent twenty years practicing the act of dying.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
